text:
ava_r: Quick heads-up — candidate (E1) asked to push start from May 12 -> June 9 due to closing on a house. Noted in offer but needs approvals for prorated benefits and split sign-on timing.

 tanya_p: Thanks. Do we need a comp-band exception for the deferred start or just benefits prorate?

 ava_r: Comp band stays the same. The wrinkle: manager asked if sign-on can be split into 50% at close + 50% 30 days after start. Also wants the relocation allowance paid after start.

 jason_k: @tanya_p we typically don't change payment schedule without finance sign-off. Also need to confirm if new start affects 401(k) eligibility date (first of month rules).

 linda_hr: FYI benefits eligibility is based on start date. If they start 6/9, medical waiting period ends same as usual. Prorate will apply to PTO accrual and pro-rated bonus eligibility for this first partial month.

 tanya_p: Ok — routing checklist: 1) manager approval (sent) 2) people-ops approval for scheduling exception 3) finance approval for split sign-on + relocation timing 4) update offer doc and onboarding tasks. @finance_ops can you confirm approval path?

 finance_ops: Can do. Need: (a) signed addendum to offer specifying split payments (b) payroll tag for "deferred-signon" and relocation note (c) confirm tax treatment — payroll needs whether to gross-up. Send to finance ops email or drop PDF here.

 ava_r: I uploaded a draft addendum here: https://files.redwood/recruiting/2149999999-addendum.pdf — it has 50/50 sign-on, relocation after start, and new start date.

 peopleops_bot: New routing created: comp-exception -> people-ops queue -> finance_ops -> HR. Reference ID: PO-2026-089. Fill the CompExceptionForm: https://forms.redwood/comp-exception

 tanya_p: Filling the form now with required approvals. Note: because band unchanged, committee review not required unless salary > band top. Confirmed salary within band.

 jason_k: One more check: the manager mentioned candidate negotiated a prorated sign-on for start delay. If we split sign-on, ensure the second tranche has retention clause (e.g., must be employed 30 days). Recommend simple clause: "Second payment subject to active employment on day 30".

 ava_r: Added that clause to the addendum. Also tagged in the hiring packet to update start date for payroll and benefits enrollment.

 finance_ops: Reviewed addendum. OK to approve split payment as long as payroll tag is created and we get gross-up instruction. I'll create payroll tag now and confirm tax handling by EOD.

 tanya_p: Thanks. Once finance posts confirmation, I'll update the offer in Greenhouse and send the signed addendum to the candidate.

 linda_hr: I'll update the benefits enrollment window and PTO pro-rate rule in the onboarding checklist once final start confirmed.

 ava_r: Great — marking this thread for close once finance confirms. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
